SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GOT < 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT < 60
GROUP BY T1.ID, T1.Birthday
ORDER BY MAX(T2.GPT) DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT < 60
  AND Patient.SEX = 'M';

SELECT MIN(T2."First Date")
FROM Patient AS T2
WHERE T2.ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH < 500
    ORDER BY LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT MAX(T2.Date)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1."First Date" = (SELECT MAX("First Date") FROM Patient)
  AND T2.LDH >= 500;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP >= 300 AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-' AND Laboratory.ALP < 300;

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TP < 6.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND l.TP > 6.0
  AND l.TP < 8.5;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5

SELECT T1.`aCL IgG`, T1.`aCL IgM`, T1.`aCL IgA`
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T2.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SEX = 'F' AND T3.UA > 6.50
ORDER BY T3.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT ID 
FROM Examination 
WHERE `aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination)
  AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRE < 1.5);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.[T-BIL] >= 2.0
  AND T2.[ANA Pattern] LIKE '%P%';

SELECT Examination.ANA
FROM Examination
JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `T-BIL` < 2.0
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-CHO` >= 250
  AND T3.KCT = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` < 250
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.TG < 200 AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG IS NOT NULL
  AND L.TG != ''
  AND CAST(L.TG AS REAL) < 200
ORDER BY CAST(L.TG AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 0
  AND L.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS L
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CPK < 250
  AND (E.KCT = '+' OR E.RVVT = '+' OR E.LAC = '+');
SELECT MIN(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU > 180;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.GLU < 180 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT > 100 AND T2.PLT < 400 AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T1.PLT
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.PLT > 100 AND T1.PLT < 400 AND T2.Diagnosis = 'MCTD';
SELECT AVG(T.PT) FROM Laboratory AS T INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON T.ID = P.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND T.PT < 14

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID)
FROM Examination E
JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE (E.Thrombosis = 2 OR E.Thrombosis = 1)
  AND L.PT < 14;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT AVG(element = 'o') AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T3.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T1.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
INNER JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'na' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element != 'br';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099' 
  AND label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'h'
GROUP BY molecule.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.atom_id AS atom1, a2.atom_id AS atom2
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.element) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T3.bond_type
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE (T1.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (T1.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND T2.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8');

SELECT DISTINCT label
FROM molecule
WHERE label NOT IN (
    SELECT m.label
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'sn'
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND a.element IN ('i', 's');

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR181';

SELECT 100.0 * (COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
                - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN m.molecule_id END))
       / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(bond.bond_type = '#') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT element
FROM (
    SELECT a.element
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
    GROUP BY a.element
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 3
) AS top_elements
ORDER BY element ASC;

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR001'
  AND c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT c2.bond_id
FROM connected c1
JOIN connected c2 ON c1.atom_id2 = c2.atom_id2
WHERE c1.atom_id = 'TR000_2';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY m.label
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT atom.element, molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR060';

SELECT b.bond_type, m.label
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY T1.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'br';

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE SUBSTR(atom.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.bond_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'p' AND T3.element = 'n';

SELECT m.label = '+' AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'i';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type, bond.bond_id
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE SUBSTR(connected.atom_id, 7, 2) + 0 = 45;

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'pb';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM bond b
   JOIN connected c  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
   JOIN atom a1      ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
   JOIN atom a2      ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
   WHERE a1.element || a2.element =
         (SELECT a1.element || a2.element
          FROM connected c2
          JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c2.atom_id
          JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c2.atom_id2
          GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
          ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
          LIMIT 1)
  ) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 's';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'sn';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T3.element)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT b.molecule_id
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
    )
  AND a.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT a2.molecule_id
        FROM atom a2
        WHERE a2.element IN ('p', 'br')
    );

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT SUM(atom.element = 'cl') * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '+'
  AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR030';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT connected.bond_id)
FROM connected
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE atom.element = 'i';
SELECT MAX(label) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'ca')

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND a.element = 'cl'
) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND a.element = 'c'
) THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END;

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'c' AND T3.bond_type = '#'
LIMIT 2;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(molecule.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT c.atom_id AS first_atom, c.atom_id2 AS second_atom
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' ELSE 'Non-Carcinogenic' END
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c';

SELECT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR151' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT *
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(molecule.molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(molecule.molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) <= 50;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.molecule_id IN (
      SELECT molecule_id
      FROM atom
      WHERE element = 'h'
  );

SELECT T3.molecule_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T3.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, T2.label
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND T1.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT bond.bond_id, connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id, a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) 
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT atom.atom_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY atom.atom_id;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS molecules_with_double_bond,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.molecule_id END) AS carcinogenic_molecules
FROM bond b
LEFT JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR001';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom
WHERE atom.atom_id IN (
    SELECT connected.atom_id
    FROM connected
    WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'
    UNION
    SELECT connected.atom_id2
    FROM connected
    WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4'
);

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_2')
   OR (a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_1');

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 's'
  AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.molecule_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T3.bond_type = '=' AND T4.label = 'TR024';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(atom.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS cnt
        FROM atom
        JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
        WHERE molecule.label = '+'
        GROUP BY atom.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'h' AND bond.bond_type = '#';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_single_bonds
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = 'TR008' AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T1.element, T2.bond_type
FROM connected AS T3
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T3.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T1 ON T3.atom_id = T1.atom_id
WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'o';

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
  AND f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1;

SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000/1/1'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores 
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE satscores.AvgScrMath > 400 
  AND schools.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500 AND sc.Magnet = 1

SELECT Phone
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`) FROM frpm);

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 560
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded';

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM satscores
JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumGE1500 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE sc.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY (sc.NumGE1500 * 1.0) / sc.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T2.District, AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) AS avg_read
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.District
ORDER BY avg_read DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT satscores.sname,
       schools.CharterNum,
       satscores.AvgScrWrite,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(T2.cds)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno'
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
ORDER BY st.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE "County Name" = 'Amador' AND "Low Grade" = '9' AND "High Grade" = '12'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM frpm WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles' AND `Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 AND `FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
SELECT sname FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE ABS(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;

SELECT DISTINCT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND t.NumGE1500 > 0;

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School, T2.FundingType
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Monterey'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND s.School LIKE '%High%';

SELECT T2.sname, T1.Phone, T2.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) > '1991' OR strftime('%Y', T1.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT T1.School, T1.DOCType
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT T1.OpenDate
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2."Low Grade" = 'K' AND T2."High Grade" = '12'
ORDER BY T2."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible FRPM Rate (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOC = 66
ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT T1.School, T1.Website
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000

SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.AdmFName1, T2.AdmLName1, T2.AdmFName2, T2.AdmLName2, T2.AdmFName3, T2.AdmLName3
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / st.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Website
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;
SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno'
SELECT T1.Phone FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.District = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT SchoolName
FROM (
    SELECT T1.School AS SchoolName,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY T1.County ORDER BY T2.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM schools AS T1
    JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
    WHERE T1.Virtual = 'F'
) AS ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT s.EILName
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE t.AvgScrMath = (SELECT MAX(AvgScrMath) FROM satscores);

SELECT T1.AvgScrMath, T2.County
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE (sc.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (sc.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND sc.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich');

SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (
      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.DOC = 31
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_avg
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = 52
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT School, ClosedDate
FROM schools
WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
  AND County = (
      SELECT County
      FROM schools
      WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
      GROUP BY County
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )

SELECT satscores.sname, schools.MailStreet
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT sc.MailStreet, sc.School
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(schools.CDSCode)
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500
  AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport';
SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS s JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE sc.MailCity = 'Fresno'

SELECT School, MailZip
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName2 = 'Atoian')

FROM schools
WHERE MailState = 'CA'
  AND County IN ('Colusa', 'Humboldt');
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailState = 'CA' AND StatusType = 'Active' AND City = 'San Joaquin'

JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds

SELECT Phone, Ext, School FROM schools WHERE Zip = '95203-3704'

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE City = 'Hickman' AND DOC = 52 AND Charter = 1

WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Stanislaus' AND FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools

  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) = '1989' 
  AND City = 'San Francisco';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11

ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC

SELECT NCESDist FROM schools WHERE SOC = 31;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE County = 'Alpine'

  AND StatusType IN ('Active', 'Closed');
SELECT District FROM schools WHERE Magnet = 0 AND City = 'Fresno'

JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

SELECT f.`Low Grade`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'

SELECT s.EILName, s.School
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Code` = '37'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = '2';

SELECT T1.City
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.EILCode = 'HS'
  AND T2."NSLP Provision Status" = '2'
  AND T2."Low Grade" = '9'

SELECT schools.School, frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND frpm.`High Grade` = '9'
  AND schools.County = 'Los Angeles';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT County, COUNT(CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT f.`School Type`, f.`School Name`, s.Latitude
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, s.School, f.`Low Grade`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(schools.CDSCode), schools.City, COUNT(schools.CDSCode)
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.Magnet = 1
  AND schools.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND frpm.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY schools.City

SELECT FirstName, District, COUNT(*) AS name_count
FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS FirstName, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2 AS FirstName, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3 AS FirstName, District FROM schools WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
) t
GROUP BY FirstName, District
ORDER BY name_count DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,
       T1.`District Code`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';
SELECT AdmLName1, District, County, School FROM schools WHERE CharterNum = '40'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
  AND StatusType = 'Public'
  AND AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail1 != ''
  AND AdmEmail2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail2 != ''
  AND AdmEmail3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail3 != ''

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1, T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon')
ORDER BY Reputation DESC

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM cust_totals
    WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON ct.Segment = m.Segment AND ct.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT Segment, pct_increase FROM (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS pct_increase
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
  ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL

         (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0

  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'

  ORDER BY pct_increase ASC
  LIMIT 1
);

       SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       > SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    THEN 'Marvel Comics'
    ELSE 'DC Comics'
  END AS publisher_with_more,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_inpatient,

       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE a.element
        WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
        WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
        WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'
        WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
        WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
        WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
        WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
        WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
        WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
        WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
        WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'
        WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
        WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
        WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
        WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
        ELSE a.element
    END AS element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

WITH admins AS (
    -- Collect every administrator first name together with the school's district
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName1) <> ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT AdmFName2, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName2) <> ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT AdmFName3, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName3) <> ''
),
top_two AS (
    -- The two most frequent administrator first names overall
    SELECT first_name
    FROM admins
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
-- Show those names and the district(s) they administer in
SELECT a.first_name,
       a.District,
       COUNT(*) AS administrator_count
FROM admins a
WHERE a.first_name IN (SELECT first_name FROM top_two)
GROUP BY a.first_name, a.District
ORDER BY a.first_name, administrator_count DESC;

     JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
     WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
       AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212) AS ConsumptionDifference;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- 2013 consumption records of customers who pay in CZK, tagged with segment
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312        -- Year 2013
),
min_consumption AS (
    -- The lowest consumption value found in each segment for 2013
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(Consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total 2013 consumption of the least-consuming
    -- customers / number of those customers, per segment
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 AS z
    JOIN min_consumption AS m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment
     AND z.Consumption = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,

    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,

    (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END))
    * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) 
      AS PercentageChange
FROM yearmonth AS ym
JOIN customers AS c 
    ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY PercentageChange DESC;

WITH station_unit_price AS (
    -- Average price per unit for each gas station
    SELECT
        g.GasStationID,
        g.Country,
        AVG(t.Price * 1.0 / t.Amount) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN gasstations g
        ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
    GROUP BY g.GasStationID, g.Country
),
overall_unit_price AS (
    -- Overall average price per unit across all transactions
    SELECT AVG(Price * 1.0 / Amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM transactions_1k
)
SELECT
    s.Country,
    COUNT(*) AS value_for_money_stations
FROM station_unit_price s
CROSS JOIN overall_unit_price o
WHERE s.avg_unit_price < o.overall_avg
GROUP BY s.Country
ORDER BY value_for_money_stations DESC;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp    ON dp.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id  = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- oldest = earliest (smallest) birth date, per the hint
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
  -- lowest average salary among those oldest female clients
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND c2.birth_date = (
                SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                FROM client
                WHERE gender = 'F'
              )
      );

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d     ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c   ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN district t ON c.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)   -- youngest client(s)
ORDER BY t.A11 DESC                                          -- highest average salary first
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'Owner';

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'                              -- approved loans
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997'             -- loan taken in 1997
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'              -- weekly statement issuance
  AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
        FROM loan l2
        WHERE l2.status = 'A'
          AND STRFTIME('%Y', l2.date) = '1997'    -- lowest approved amount in 1997
  );

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date LIKE '1993%'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d     ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a  ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND dt.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT t1.account_id
FROM trans AS t1
WHERE t1.date = (
    SELECT MIN(t2.date)
    FROM trans AS t2
    WHERE t2.date LIKE '1995%'
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date AS account_open_date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT a.district_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.date = '1994-08-25'
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT MAX(trans.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN trans ON disp.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount AS first_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a
    ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = (
        -- account that took out the biggest loan
        SELECT l.account_id
        FROM loan l
        ORDER BY l.amount DESC
        LIMIT 1
      )
  AND t.date >= a.date          -- transaction occurred after the account was opened
ORDER BY t.date ASC             -- earliest transaction first
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_clients
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND a.date LIKE '1996%';

SELECT district.A2
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_client_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY d.A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT
    ((t_end.balance - t_start.balance) * 100.0) / t_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN trans t_start
     ON t_start.account_id = l.account_id
    AND t_start.date = '1993-03-22'
JOIN trans t_end
     ON t_end.account_id = l.account_id
    AND t_end.date = '1998-12-27'
WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'          -- loan approved on 1993/7/5
ORDER BY l.loan_id ASC               -- "first" loan approved on that date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS district_region
FROM account a
JOIN district d
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.account_id,
    T1.frequency
FROM account AS T1
JOIN disp    AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client  AS T3 ON T2.client_id  = T3.client_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T4.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND T2.type = 'OWNER'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district, 
    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT 
    l.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    d.A3 AS district,
    d.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT 
    d.district_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    ((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12) AS unemployment_rate_increment_percentage
FROM loan l
JOIN account a 
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
         2
       ) AS pct_decin_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT d.A2 AS district,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp disp ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts_without_credit_cards
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM disp dp
        JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
        WHERE dp.account_id = a.account_id
  );

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')   -- active/running contracts
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT A3 AS branch_location, 
       A2 AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) 
             FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND t.balance < 0
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND l.date <= '1997-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT
    d.district_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t   ON t.account_id  = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1997';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(monthly_total) AS avg_monthly_credit_card_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', date) AS month,
           SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', date)
) AS monthly;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d  ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'                -- credit card withdrawals
  AND t.amount < (SELECT AVG(t2.amount)
                  FROM trans t2
                  WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU')   -- average credit card amount
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998';

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date,
    a.account_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount  AS loan_amount,
    l.status
FROM client c
JOIN disp    d  ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN card    cd ON cd.disp_id   = d.disp_id
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN loan    l  ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN disp    ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client  ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND district.A3 = 'south Bohemia';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT d.type AS account_type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type <> 'OWNER'
  AND di.A11 > 8000
  AND di.A11 <= 9000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ';

SELECT AVG(d.A15) AS avg_crimes_1995
FROM district d
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
  AND d.district_id IN (
      SELECT a.district_id
      FROM account a
      WHERE a.date >= '1997-01-01'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS classic_cards_eligible_for_loan
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'classic'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
  AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT c.client_id,
       c.gender,
       c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d  ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND l.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan);

SELECT d.A15 AS crimes_1995
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.account_id = 532;

SELECT a.district_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE o.order_id = 33333;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount < 200000;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3 AS region
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.client_id = 3541;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY num_accounts DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
FROM "order" o
JOIN disp d   ON o.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE o.order_id = 32423;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 5;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik';

SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'junior'
  AND c.issued >= '1997-01-01';

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END)
        / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id),
    2) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp     d  ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account  a  ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '97' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     -
     SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    * 100.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d   ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS credit_card_withdrawals
FROM trans
WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND date >= '1996-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS disposition_count
FROM disp
WHERE account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
  AND type IN ('OWNER', 'DISPONENT');

SELECT
    a.frequency,   -- how often the account statement is released
    t.k_symbol     -- the aim/purpose of the debit of 3539
FROM account a
JOIN trans t
    ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 3
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'     -- debit (withdrawal/expense) transactions
  AND t.amount = 3539;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount          AS debt_amount,
    l.payments        AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration        AS duration_months,
    l.status          AS status_code,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid (debt remains)'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Contract still running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Contract still running - client IN DEBT'
    END               AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_following_trans_851,
       c.gender      AS owner_gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp    d ON d.client_id   = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id  = d.account_id
JOIN trans   t ON t.account_id  = a.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 4
  AND t.date > (SELECT date
                FROM trans
                WHERE trans_id = 851);

SELECT c.type
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
WHERE cl.client_id = 9;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 617
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1999-01-01';

SELECT DISTINCT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d
    ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account AS a
    ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district AS dt
    ON dt.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date BETWEEN '1983-01-01' AND '1987-12-31'
  AND dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND c.birth_date BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31'
  AND t.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND t.amount > 4000;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND a.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_junior_card_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND cd.type = 'junior';

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*),
         2
       ) AS pct_female
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender
    FROM client    c
    JOIN disp      d ON d.client_id    = c.client_id
    JOIN account   a ON a.account_id   = d.account_id
    JOIN district  t ON t.district_id  = a.district_id
    WHERE t.A3 = 'Prague'
) AS prague_clients;

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d    ON d.client_id   = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id  = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) AS num_owners
FROM disp
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS account_opening_date,
    l.amount AS approved_amount,
    l.duration
FROM loan l
JOIN account a 
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 24
  AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
        FROM loan l2
        JOIN account a2 
            ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
        WHERE l2.duration > 24
          AND a2.date < '1997-01-01'
  );

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d 
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a 
    ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt 
    ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC,   -- oldest first (earliest birth date)
         dt.A11 ASC          -- then lowest average salary
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_clients
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE SUBSTR(client.birth_date, 1, 4) = '1920'
  AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.duration = 24
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
