JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
ORDER BY s.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_fastest_superheroes
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute 
    ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT
    SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics')                                   AS dc_comics_count,
    SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')                               AS marvel_comics_count,
    SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - SUM(p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT T1.attribute_name
FROM attribute AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.attribute_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
ORDER BY T2.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_good
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS hp
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_outpatient_count,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
        2
    ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 1930 THEN 1 END) AS REAL) 
    * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female_born_after_1930
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F';

SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS REAL) /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS inpatient_outpatient_ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT 
    P.Diagnosis, 
    L.Date
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L 
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.ID = '30609';

SELECT
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    E.`Examination Date`,
    E.Symptoms
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH > 500;

SELECT T1.ID,
       strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND T2.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN L.TP < 6.0 OR L.TP > 8.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(L.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`) AS average_aCL_IgG
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) >= 50;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', Description) = '1997'
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT MIN(YEAR(`First Date`) - YEAR(Birthday)) AS youngest_age
FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND T2.`Thrombosis` = '1'
  AND T1.`SEX` = 'F';

SELECT
    MAX(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER))
  - MIN(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200;

SELECT E.Symptoms, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) / 12.0 AS avg_male_patients_per_month
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    T1.Date AS LabWorkDate,
    STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS AgeAtFirstVisit
FROM Patient AS T2
JOIN Laboratory AS T1 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE YEAR(T2.`Examination Date`) - YEAR(T1.`First Date`) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS underage_patients
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.`T-BIL` >= '2.0'

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT SUBTRACT(year(E.`Examination Date`), year(P.Birthday)) AS Age,
       P.Diagnosis AS Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS E
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
ORDER BY L.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT `ANA`
FROM Examination
WHERE `ID` = 3605340
  AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN `T-CHO` < 250 THEN 'Yes, normal level'
        ELSE 'No, not normal level'
    END AS Cholesterol_Status
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 2927464
  AND Date = '1995-09-04';

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY `First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' 
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', L.Date) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.UA = '8.4'
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) AS Total_Laboratory_Tests
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1995';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT E.Symptoms
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-03-01'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993-09-27';

SELECT 
    (
        SELECT SUM(L.`T-CHO`) 
        FROM Laboratory AS L 
        JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID 
        WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18' 
          AND L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%'
    ) 
    - 
    (
        SELECT SUM(L.`T-CHO`) 
        FROM Laboratory AS L 
        JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID 
        WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18' 
          AND L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%'
    ) AS decrease_rate;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E
        ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND P.Description >= '1997-01-01'
  AND P.Description < '1998-01-01';

SELECT DISTINCT ID
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND GPT > 30
  AND ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(ID), ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', `First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.BIRTHDAY) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(L.ALB) AS average_albumin
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.PLT > 400
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT Symptoms, COUNT(Symptoms) AS NumOfSymptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE YEAR(DATE) = '1997'
  AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT
    SUM(Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%') * 100.0
        / SUM(Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%') AS proportion
FROM Examination
WHERE Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE YEAR(BIRTHDAY) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT DATEDIFF(e.`Examination Date`, p.`First Date`)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA > 8.0) 
           OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA > 6.5) 
         THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS uric_acid_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.ID = 57266;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = '48473'
  AND GOT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1994'
  AND T2.GOT < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.GPT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT > 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    Patient.ID, 
    (YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.Admission
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ALP < 300;

SELECT T1.ID, 
       T2.ALP < 300 AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TP < 6.0;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    T2.Date,
    T1.SEX,
    T2.TP,
    T2.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM 
    Patient AS T1
JOIN 
    Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE 
    T1.SEX = 'F'
    AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes - within normal range'
        ELSE 'No - outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.UA > 6.5 THEN l.ID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.`Date` = (
        SELECT MAX(l2.`Date`)
        FROM Laboratory l2
        WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
      )
  AND (
        (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
     OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND l.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     > SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS result
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`)
    FROM Laboratory
);

SELECT 
    p.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT p.ID          AS patient_id,
       l.`T-CHO`     AS t_cho_index
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l
     ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`)
                   FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND "T-CHO" >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200
  AND (YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.SEX, 
    YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU >= 180 
  AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991'
  AND T2.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5 OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY P.SEX ASC, P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.Diagnosis, 
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(T1.Birthday)) >= 50
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.HGB < 10;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.HGB > 10
  AND T2.HGB < 17
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.ID,
       STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID
HAVING COUNT(T2.ID) > 2;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50
  AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100
       / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_abnormal_PT_percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
  ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992'
  AND T2.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.WBC > 3.5 AND T2.WBC < 9.0
  AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.`U-PRO` > 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS num_patients

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination e

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

FROM Laboratory AS L

WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1

    ORDER BY P.`First Date` DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND T2.ALP >= 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT Date

LIMIT 1;

FROM Patient AS T1

  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT

LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS highest_ana_level

SELECT T1.ID

JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID

ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1

FROM Examination AS e

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond

ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_oxygen_atoms

    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T3.atom_id)
FROM molecule AS T1

    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond

SELECT COUNT(*)

  AND label = '+';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id

LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type

JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
HAVING COUNT(a.element) = (
    SELECT MIN(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '-'
        GROUP BY a2.element
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8');

SELECT DISTINCT label
FROM molecule
WHERE label NOT IN (
    SELECT m.label
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'sn'
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2     ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.molecule_id = 'TR181'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN atom a2     ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a1.molecule_id = 'TR181';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN f_cnt = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        a.molecule_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f_cnt
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m 
        ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
) AS molecule_stats;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;

SELECT a1.atom_id, a1.element, a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM connected c

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

SELECT bond_id
FROM connected
WHERE atom_id2 IN (
    SELECT atom_id2

    WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2'
);

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0

         5
       ) AS percentage
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008';

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percentage
FROM molecule;

SELECT a.element, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR060';

SELECT b.bond_type, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' 
  AND T2.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY T1.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT connected.bond_id) 
FROM connected
INNER JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.molecule_id = 'TR009'
  AND (connected.atom_id = 'TR009_12' 
       OR connected.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND atom.element = 'br';

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'not carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25'

SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')

SELECT CASE
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(c.bond_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS avg_num_bonds

JOIN connected AS c

SELECT b.bond_type, c.bond_id

JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, a1.element AS atom1_element,

SELECT a.element

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT T2.atom_id2

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

SELECT c.atom_id2

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements

        SELECT a2.molecule_id

        WHERE a2.element IN ('p', 'br')
      );

SELECT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '+'
  AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR030';

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id  = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.bond_id) 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
WHERE T1.element = 'i';

SELECT MAX(m.label), COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'c';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'c'
  AND T3.bond_type = '#'
  AND T1.label = '-'
LIMIT 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' 
        ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' 
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) AS count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio,
    m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c';

SELECT a1.element AS element_1, a2.element AS element_2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN b.molecule_id END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS pct_triple_bond
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic' 
            ELSE 'Not carcinogenic' 
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR151'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'br', 'pb');

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE CAST(substr(m.molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND CAST(substr(m.molecule_id, 3, 3) AS INTEGER) <= 50
  AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'h'
  AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        * 100.0 / COUNT(a.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

SELECT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR124'
  AND label = '+';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    m.label AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
    AND b.bond_type = ' = '
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id, 
       c.atom_id, 
       c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
)
ORDER BY m.molecule_id, a.element;

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b 
    ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id)
     FROM bond
     WHERE bond_type = '=') AS double_bond_molecules,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
     FROM bond b
     JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
     WHERE b.bond_type = '='
       AND m.label = '+') AS carcinogenic_double_bond_molecules;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
    )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    );

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'cl' THEN m.molecule_id END)
          / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a
    ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c
  ON a.atom_id  = c.atom_id
  OR a.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_1');

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS num_carcinogenic_nitrogen_molecules
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a        ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c   ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b        ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element   = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.molecule_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b      ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a      ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR024'
  AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b  ON c.bond_id  = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a1.element = 'h'
  AND a2.element = 'h'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) 
FROM bond 
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010' 
  AND bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = 'TR008' AND atom.element = 'c';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR004_7'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o'
  AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_molecules_with_triple_bonds
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+' AND T1.element = 'o';

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `School Type` = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T1.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'

SELECT schools.MailStreet
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T1.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 400 AND T2.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT T2.School
FROM schools AS T2
JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND T2.Magnet = 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.School) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 560 AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly funded'

SELECT f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CDSCode 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT MAX(T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.NumGE1500 / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    sc.School,
    sc.NCESSchool,
    fr.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm fr
JOIN schools sc ON fr.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY fr.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T2.District
FROM schools AS T2
JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.District
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT 
    s.sname, 
    s.AvgScrWrite, 
    sc.CharterNum
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Fresno'
  AND T2.`District Type` = 'Directly Funded'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
ORDER BY T2.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `County Name` = 'Amador' 
  AND `Low Grade` = 9 
  AND `High Grade` = 12;

SELECT COUNT(s.School)
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700;

SELECT sname 
FROM satscores 
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' 
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    frpm.`School Name`,
    schools.Street,
    schools.City,
    schools.Zip,
    schools.State
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30;

SELECT T2.sname
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / T1."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND T2."NumGE1500" >= 1500;

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT 
    s.sname, 
    s.AvgScrWrite, 
    sc.Phone
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc 
    ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE strftime('%Y', sc.OpenDate) > '1991' 
   OR strftime('%Y', sc.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
        SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
        FROM frpm f2
        JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
        WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
      );

SELECT T2.OpenDate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    `School Name`,
    `Enrollment (K-12)`,
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (K-12)`
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT 
    frpm.`School Name`,
    frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_FRPM_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.DOC = '66'
ORDER BY frpm.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT schools.School, schools.Website
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    schools.AdmFName1 || ' ' || schools.AdmLName1 AS Administrator1,
    schools.AdmFName2 || ' ' || schools.AdmLName2 AS Administrator2,
    schools.AdmFName3 || ' ' || schools.AdmLName3 AS Administrator3
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / st.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT schools.Website
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE satscores.cname = 'Los Angeles'
  AND satscores.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.City = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT School
FROM (
    SELECT s.School,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY st.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
) ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT s.EILName
FROM satscores AS sa
JOIN schools AS s ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.sname, AVG(T2.AvgScrWrite)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich')
GROUP BY T2.sname

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC, T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) / 12 
FROM schools 
WHERE County = 'Alameda' 
  AND DOC = 52

WITH CustomerTotal AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK-paying customer, per segment
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y
        ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
MinPerSegment AS (
    -- The lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM CustomerTotal
    GROUP BY Segment
),
AnnualAverage AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption
    -- customer(s) / number of those customers
    SELECT
        ct.Segment,
        SUM(ct.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM CustomerTotal AS ct
    INNER JOIN MinPerSegment AS m
        ON ct.Segment = m.Segment
       AND ct.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM AnnualAverage WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

WITH EUR_Yearly AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
Pct AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (Cons_2013 - Cons_2012) * 100.0 / Cons_2013 AS Percentage_Increase
    FROM EUR_Yearly
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase
FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase
      FROM Pct
      ORDER BY Percentage_Increase DESC
      LIMIT 1) AS Biggest
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase
FROM (SELECT Segment, Percentage_Increase
      FROM Pct
      ORDER BY Percentage_Increase ASC
      LIMIT 1) AS Lowest;

      M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
      M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
      M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
      M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
  )
JOIN Country C
  ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P 
    ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M 
    ON  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_1
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_2
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_3
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_4
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_5
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_6
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_7
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_8
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_9
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_10
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.home_player_11
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_1
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_2
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_3
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_4
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_5
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_6
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_7
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_8
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_9
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_10
    OR  PA.player_api_id = M.away_player_11
JOIN Country AS C 
    ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM (
    SELECT mp.country_id, AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
    FROM (
        SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
    ) AS mp
    JOIN Player AS p
        ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
    GROUP BY mp.country_id
) AS t
JOIN Country AS c
    ON c.id = t.country_id
ORDER BY t.avg_weight DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT m.label

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id

SELECT m.label

SELECT COUNT(c.bond_id) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS avg_bonds_per_iodine_atom

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element

SELECT m.molecule_id

SELECT a.element

SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id2

SELECT DISTINCT a.element

SELECT

SELECT T2.atom_id2

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element) AS num_elements

SELECT
    frpm.`School Name`,
    frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools
    ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation High School'
  AND frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education';

SELECT schools.MailStreet
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode

  AND schools.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode

SELECT CDSCode

) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds

WITH cust_totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (only those paying in CZK)
    SELECT c.Segment,
           c.CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    -- Minimum (least) total consumption per segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS lowest_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average of the lowest-consuming customers per segment
    -- = total consumption of those customers / number of those customers
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN lowest l
      ON l.Segment = ct.Segment
     AND l.lowest_consumption = ct.total_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH eur_consumption AS (
    -- Total consumption per segment per year, only for EUR-paying customers
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption)   AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
segment_totals AS (
    -- Pivot yearly sums into one row per segment
    SELECT
        Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM eur_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
pct_change AS (
    -- Percentage of increase = (2013 consumption - 2012 consumption) / 2013 consumption * 100
    SELECT
        Segment,
        ROUND((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013, 2) AS percentage_increase
    FROM segment_totals
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct_change ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct_change ORDER BY percentage_increase ASC  LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment;

FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Heart of Midlothian';

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino';

SELECT SUM(T1.crossing) AS total_crossing_score
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Lennox';

SELECT 
    T2.chanceCreationPassing,
    T2.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 
    ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'Ajax'
ORDER BY T2.chanceCreationPassing DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT preferred_foot
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) AS highest_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT AVG(m.away_team_goal) AS average_away_goals
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Team AS t 
    ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN Country AS c 
    ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Parma'
  AND c.name = 'Italy';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P 
    ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = 77
  AND PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    PA.overall_rating
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'
    AND PA.date LIKE '2016-02-04%';

SELECT 
    PA.potential
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini'
    AND PA.date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00';

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT 
    PA.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE 
    P.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
    AND PA.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT T1.date
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  AND T1.crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(T3.crossing)
      FROM Player_Attributes AS T3
      JOIN Player AS T4 
          ON T3.player_api_id = T4.player_api_id
      WHERE T4.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
  )
ORDER BY T1.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Willem II'
  AND TA.date = '2012-02-22';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T
  ON TA.team_fifa_api_id = T.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'LEI'
  AND TA.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00';

SELECT T_Attributes.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS T_Attributes
JOIN Team ON T_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient'
  AND T_Attributes.date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT T2.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle'
  AND T2.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00';

SELECT T2.chanceCreationCrossingClass
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'Hull City'
  AND T2.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT T2.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND T2.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
    AND SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT 
    ((T1.overall_rating - T2.overall_rating) * 100.0) / T1.overall_rating AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS P1 
    ON T1.player_api_id = P1.player_api_id
JOIN Player AS P2 
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 
    ON T2.player_api_id = P2.player_api_id
WHERE P1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
  AND P2.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
  AND T1.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
  AND T2.date LIKE '2013-07-12%';

SELECT player_name
FROM (
    SELECT player_name,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM Player
) AS ranked_players
WHERE height_rank = 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player
ORDER BY weight DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p 
    ON p.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'
WHERE m.home_player_1  = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_2  = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_3  = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_4  = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_5  = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_6  = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_7  = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_8  = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_9  = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_10 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_11 = p.player_api_id;

SELECT SUM(M.away_team_goal) AS total_away_goals
FROM Match M
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Player P
        WHERE P.player_name = 'Daan Smith'
          AND P.player_api_id IN (M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,
                                  M.away_player_4,  M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,
                                  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
                                  M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Player P
        WHERE P.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira'
          AND P.player_api_id IN (M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,
                                  M.away_player_4,  M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,
                                  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,  M.away_player_9,
                                  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
      );

SELECT SUM(M.home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
FROM Match M
INNER JOIN Player P 
    ON M.home_player_1 = P.player_api_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) AS INTEGER) 
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.birthday) AS INTEGER) < 31;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.attacking_work_rate = 'high';

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.finishing = 1
ORDER BY julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - julianday(T1.birthday) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M
  ON P.player_api_id IN (
        M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
        M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
        M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
        M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
        M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
        M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
     )
JOIN Country AS C
  ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Belgium';

WITH high_vision AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE vision > 89
)
SELECT DISTINCT C.name AS country
FROM Country C
WHERE C.id IN (
    SELECT M.country_id
    FROM Match M
    WHERE M.home_player_1  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.home_player_2  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.home_player_3  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.home_player_4  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.home_player_5  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.home_player_6  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.home_player_7  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.home_player_8  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.home_player_9  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.home_player_10 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.home_player_11 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.away_player_1  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.away_player_2  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.away_player_3  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.away_player_4  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.away_player_5  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.away_player_6  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.away_player_7  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.away_player_8  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.away_player_9  IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.away_player_10 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
       OR M.away_player_11 IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM high_vision)
);

WITH match_players AS (
    -- Flatten all 22 player columns of each match into (country, player) pairs
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
    SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
),
country_players AS (
    -- Keep each player only once per country so repeated appearances don't skew the average
    SELECT DISTINCT country_id, player_api_id
    FROM match_players
)
SELECT c.name AS country_name,
       AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
FROM country_players cp
JOIN Player  p ON p.player_api_id = cp.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = cp.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC   -- implements MAX(AVG(weight))
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

WITH ItalianMatches AS (
    SELECT M.home_player_1,  M.home_player_2,  M.home_player_3,  M.home_player_4,
           M.home_player_5,  M.home_player_6,  M.home_player_7,  M.home_player_8,
           M.home_player_9,  M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
           M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,
           M.away_player_5,  M.away_player_6,  M.away_player_7,  M.away_player_8,
           M.away_player_9,  M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    FROM Match M
    JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
    WHERE C.name = 'Italy'
),
ItalianPlayerIds AS (
    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_id FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9  FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM ItalianMatches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM ItalianMatches
)
SELECT AVG(DISTINCT P.height) AS average_height
FROM Player P
JOIN ItalianPlayerIds I
    ON P.player_api_id = I.player_id;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(id) AS num_players
FROM Player
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT 
    (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) 
    - 
    (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes)
  AND preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
    * 100 / COUNT(id) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT 
    m.home_team_goal,
    m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
  AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT 
    PA.sprint_speed, 
    PA.agility, 
    PA.acceleration
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_games
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND l.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT MAX(m.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_score
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa 
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT
    L.name AS league_name,
    COUNT(M.id) AS num_games
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
ORDER BY M.away_team_goal DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.height < 180 AND PA.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(P.id) AS percentage
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' 
        ELSE '1996' 
    END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_male_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    disp.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - district.A11 AS gap
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY client.birth_date ASC, district.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT account.account_id
FROM client
JOIN disp     ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account  ON disp.account_id  = account.account_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND district.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND T2.status = 'A'
  AND T2.date LIKE '97%'
  AND T2.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(T3.amount)
      FROM loan AS T3
      WHERE T3.status = 'A'
        AND T3.date LIKE '97%'
  )

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id) AS num_female_customers
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.birth_date) < '1950'
  AND T2.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE date = (
    SELECT MIN(date)
    FROM trans
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
);

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE account.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND trans.balance > 3000;

SELECT T2.client_id
FROM card AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id
WHERE T1.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT account.district_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25'
  AND loan.status = 'A';

SELECT MAX(trans.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM trans
JOIN disp ON trans.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = (
        SELECT l.account_id
        FROM loan AS l
        ORDER BY l.amount DESC
        LIMIT 1
      )
  AND t.date >= a.date          -- transaction must be on/after the account opening date
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_clients
FROM account a
JOIN district d  ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN disp dp     ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c    ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT district.A2
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND client.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id

WITH target_client AS (
    -- Find the loan approved (status = 'C') on 1993-07-05, take the first one,
    -- and get the client & account linked to it
    SELECT d.client_id, l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
      AND l.status = 'C'          -- 'C' = running/approved contract
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    -- Account balance on 1993-03-22
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_client tc ON t.account_id = tc.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    -- Account balance on 1998-12-27
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target_client tc ON t.account_id = tc.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (balance_end.balance - balance_start.balance) * 100.0
       / balance_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_start, balance_end;

yearly_totals AS (

        SUM(CASE WHEN l.date LIKE '96%' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_1996,
