            SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 1930 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent_inpatient
FROM Patient
WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = '30609';

SELECT 
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    E.`Examination Date`,
    E.Symptoms
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH > 500;

SELECT T1.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND T2.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND (L.TP < '6.0' OR L.TP > '8.5') 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) * 100.0 / COUNT(P.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(E.`aCL IgG`) AS average_aCL_IgG
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '+'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50;

SELECT COUNT(ID) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'F' 
  AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997' 
  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', `First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND T2.`Thrombosis` = '1'
  AND T1.`SEX` = 'F';

SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.Birthday = (
      SELECT MAX(p2.Birthday)
      FROM Patient p2
      JOIN Examination e2 ON p2.ID = e2.ID
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12.0 AS avg_male_patients_per_month
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT 
    L.Date AS Lab_Work_Date,
    STRFTIME('%Y', P.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age_At_First_Visit
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l
  ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0')
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', Examination.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER)
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', E."Examination Date") AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age,
    E.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
ORDER BY L.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ANA
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = 3605340
  AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE ID = 2927464 
  AND Date = '1995-09-04' 
  AND `T-CHO` < 250;

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY `First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E
        ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T2
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4'
  AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT COUNT(T2.ID) AS total_lab_tests
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1995';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959/3/1'
  AND e.[Examination Date] = '1993/9/27';

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(T.`T-CHO`) 
     FROM Laboratory AS T 
     JOIN Patient AS P ON T.ID = P.ID 
     WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18' 
       AND T.Date LIKE '1981-11-%')
    -
    (SELECT SUM(T.`T-CHO`) 
     FROM Laboratory AS T 
     JOIN Patient AS P ON T.ID = P.ID 
     WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18' 
       AND T.Date LIKE '1981-12-%') AS Decrease_Rate;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` >= '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` < '1998-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_ids
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND GPT > 30
  AND ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS patient_count, ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+'
GROUP BY ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
INNER JOIN Examination AS e
        ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2
  AND e.ANA = 'S'
  AND e.`aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2      -- average + 20% of average
        FROM Examination
      );

SELECT SUM(Diagnosis = 'BEHCET') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', `First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P' 
  AND T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(l.ALB) AS average_albumin
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.PLT > 400;

SELECT T1.Description, T2.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = 48473;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE strftime('%Y', DATE) = '1997'
  AND NOT (TP > 6 AND TP < 8.5);

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND p.Admission = '-'
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND e.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(julianday(Examination.`Examination Date`) - julianday(Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS is_normal
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.ID = 57266
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA > 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA > 6.5)
      );

SELECT T1.`Date`
FROM Laboratory AS T1
WHERE T1.ID = '48473'
  AND T1.GOT >= 60;

SELECT P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT < 60
  AND strftime('%Y', L.Date) = '1994';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT > 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS Age
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALP < 300;

SELECT 
    p.ID, 
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes - within normal range' 
        ELSE 'No - above normal range' 
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TP < 6.0;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    T2.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT
    P.ID,
    P.Birthday,
    L.ALB,
    CASE
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA > 6.5 THEN T1.ID END) * 100.0 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN T1.ID END) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID;

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
        -- latest laboratory exam for each patient
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
      )
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS result
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT L.ID,
       P.SEX,
       P.Birthday,
       L."T-BIL" AS Highest_Total_Bilirubin
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L."T-BIL" = (
    SELECT MAX("T-BIL")
    FROM Laboratory
);

SELECT 
    Patient.SEX,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT 
    P.ID AS Patient_ID,
    L.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
           - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
       / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' 
  AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200
  AND (strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-'
  AND T2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.SEX, 
    (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU >= 180 
  AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250;

SELECT P.ID, L.GLU
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Description) = '1991'
  AND L.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L
    ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5
   OR L.WBC >= 9.0
GROUP BY
    P.SEX,
    P.ID,
    P.Birthday
ORDER BY
    P.SEX ASC,
    P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.ID,
    T1.Diagnosis,
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.Admission
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
  AND (L.RBC <= 3.5 OR L.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T2.SEX
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Admission = '-'
  AND T1.HGB < 10;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.HGB > 10
  AND T2.HGB < 17
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T2.ID
HAVING COUNT(T2.ID) > 2;

SELECT AVG(HCT)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date LIKE '1991%'
  AND HCT < 29;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_normal,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', L.Date) AS INTEGER) = 1984
  AND (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 50
  AND L.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) > 55
  AND Laboratory.PT >= 14;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday, T1.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992'
  AND T2.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.APTT >= 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.WBC > 3.5
  AND T2.WBC < 9.0
  AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
  AND L.IGA = (
      SELECT MAX(IGA)
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGA > 80
  AND Laboratory.IGA < 500
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(Patient.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGM <= 40 OR T2.IGM >= 400
GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+'
  AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 1985
  AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND T3.Thrombosis = '0';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.C3 > 35
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.HCT <= 29 OR T2.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T3.`aCL IgA`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
ORDER BY P.`First Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Examination.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.DNA >= 8;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900 
  AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000 
  AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 
    / 
    COUNT(Laboratory.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' 
  AND Laboratory.GOT < 60;

SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT < 60
ORDER BY T2.GPT DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GOT < 60
  AND p.SEX = 'M';

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS first_recorded_date
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
  AND L.LDH = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.LDH)
        FROM Laboratory AS L2
        WHERE L2.LDH < 500
  );

SELECT T1.Date
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2
        ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`First Date` = (SELECT MAX(`First Date`) FROM Patient)
  AND T1.LDH >= 500;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP >= 300
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-'
  AND T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TP < 6.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' 
  AND T2.TP > 6.0 
  AND T2.TP < 8.5;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT 
    E.`aCL IgG`, 
    E.`aCL IgM`, 
    E.`aCL IgA`
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' 
  AND L.UA > 6.50
ORDER BY L.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA)
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
WHERE E.`aCL IgA` = (
    SELECT MAX(E2.`aCL IgA`)
    FROM Examination AS E2
    WHERE E2.ID IN (
        SELECT L.ID
        FROM Laboratory AS L
        WHERE L.CRE < 1.5
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT E.ANA
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` < 2.0
ORDER BY L.`T-BIL` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-CHO` >= 250
  AND T3.KCT = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-CHO` < 250
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.TG < 200 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 0
  AND T3.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CPK < 250
  AND (E.KCT = '+' OR E.RVVT = '+' OR E.LAC = '+');

SELECT MIN(T1.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU > 180;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.GLU < 180
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE (L.RBC <= 3.5 OR L.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.PLT > 100 
    AND T2.PLT < 400 
    AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T1.PLT
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.PLT > 100
  AND T1.PLT < 400
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'MCTD';

SELECT AVG(T1.PT) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis IN (1, 2)
  AND T3.PT < 14

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
  AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT a.molecule_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oxygen_count
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '-'
    )
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
) AS molecule_oxygen;

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
        / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN atom      ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN bond      ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND m.molecule_id IN (
      SELECT a.molecule_id
      FROM atom a
      WHERE a.element = 'na'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS carcinogenic_count
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099'
  AND label = '+';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
GROUP BY m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(m.label) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id2
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a1.atom_id   AS atom_1,
    a1.element   AS element_1,
    a2.atom_id   AS atom_2,
    a2.element   AS element_2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b  ON c.bond_id  = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT c.atom_id,
       c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1
     ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2
     ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS m1
     ON a1.molecule_id = m1.molecule_id
JOIN molecule AS m2
     ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
WHERE m1.label = '-'
  AND m2.label = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.label = '-'
)
GROUP BY a.element
HAVING COUNT(a.element) = (
    SELECT MIN(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM atom
        WHERE molecule_id IN (
            SELECT molecule_id
            FROM molecule
            WHERE label = '-'
        )
        GROUP BY element
    ) AS element_counts
);

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_20')
   OR (c.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR004_8');

SELECT DISTINCT label
FROM molecule
WHERE label NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.label
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'sn'
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T4 ON T2.atom_id2 = T4.atom_id
WHERE T3.bond_type = '-'
  AND T1.element = 'i'
  AND T4.element = 's';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c 
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m 
    ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR181';

SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN m.molecule_id NOT IN (
                    SELECT a.molecule_id
                    FROM atom a
                    WHERE a.element = 'f'
                 )
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS pct_carcinogenic_without_fluorine
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    a1.atom_id  AS atom1_id,
    a1.element  AS atom1_element,
    a2.atom_id  AS atom2_id,
    a2.element  AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR001';

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) 
     FROM molecule 
     WHERE label = '+') 
    - 
    (SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) 
     FROM molecule 
     WHERE label = '-') AS difference;

SELECT bond_id
FROM connected
WHERE atom_id2 IN (
    SELECT atom_id2
    FROM connected
    WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_2'
);

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
ORDER BY b.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ROUND(
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 
    / COUNT(bond_id), 
    5
) AS double_bond_percentage
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR008';

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(molecule_id), 
       3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT a.element, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR060';

SELECT 
    b.bond_type, 
    m.label
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
  AND T2.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY T1.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR009'
  AND (c.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule 
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+' 
  AND atom.element = 'br';

SELECT 
    b.bond_type, 
    c.atom_id, 
    c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    molecule.molecule_id,
    molecule.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Not carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom
JOIN molecule 
    ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.bond_id, T1.bond_type
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN connected AS T4 ON T1.bond_id = T4.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T5 ON T4.atom_id2 = T5.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'p'
  AND T5.element = 'n';

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(c.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS avg_num_bonds
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'i';

SELECT T2.bond_type, T1.bond_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, 7, 2) + 0 = 45;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id   FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id,
       c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'          -- carcinogenic molecules only
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '    -- double bonds only
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id, a2.element
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id2 = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'pb';

SELECT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
         / COUNT(b.bond_id), 
       5) AS proportion_single_bonds_carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 's'

SELECT DISTINCT T2.bond_type
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'sn';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_atoms
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND (a.element = 'p' OR a.element = 'br');

SELECT bond.bond_id
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' 
  AND T1.label = '-';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom AS T2
WHERE T2.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT T1.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS T1
    WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'
);

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS total_carcinogenic_molecules
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '+'
  AND molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR030';

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'i'
   OR a2.element = 'i';

SELECT MAX(T2.label)          AS majority_label,
       COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
GROUP BY T2.label
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS has_cl_and_c
FROM connected AS conn
JOIN atom AS a1 ON conn.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON conn.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE conn.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND (
        (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')   -- a1 is chlorine, a2 is carbon
     OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl')  -- a1 is carbon,   a2 is chlorine
      );

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'c'
LIMIT 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN A.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(A.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM atom AS A
JOIN molecule AS M ON A.molecule_id = M.molecule_id
WHERE M.label = '+';

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' 
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element,
       COUNT(atom.element) AS total
FROM atom
JOIN molecule
  ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio,
    m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM bond
JOIN atom ON bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c';

SELECT a1.element AS element_atom1,
       a2.element AS element_atom2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = '#' THEN molecule_id END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS percent_triple_bond_compounds
FROM bond;

SELECT 
    molecule_id,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
        / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047'
GROUP BY molecule_id;

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_1';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR151';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2
    ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c'
  AND substr(T2.molecule_id, 3, 3) >= 10
  AND substr(T2.molecule_id, 3, 3) <= 50;

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'h'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' AND T2.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
    / COUNT(T2.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id;

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT 
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count,
    m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b 
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, atom.element
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    c.atom_id,
    c.atom_id2,
    b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)                                AS molecules_with_double_bond,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)               AS carcinogenic_molecules
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
) AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE element = 's'
      )
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '='
      );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.element) AS num_elements
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

SELECT bond.bond_type
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE connected.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
  AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT bond.molecule_id
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE connected.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND connected.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+' 
  AND T2.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a      ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
JOIN bond b      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element  = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '='
  AND m.label = 'TR024';

SELECT a.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b     ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND a1.element = 'h'
  AND a2.element = 'h'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_single_bonds
FROM bond
WHERE bond.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_carbons
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR008'
  AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR004_7'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT atom.element, bond.bond_type
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c 
    ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND atom.element = 'o';

SELECT
    `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'
  AND T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1;

SELECT T2.MailStreet
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND T2.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND T2.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE Virtual = 'F' 
  AND CDSCode IN (
      SELECT CDSCode 
      FROM satscores 
      WHERE AvgScrMath > 400
  );

SELECT s.school_name
FROM schools AS s
JOIN sat_scores AS sr ON s.school_id = sr.school_id
WHERE sr.num_test_takers > 500
  AND s.magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.NumTstTakr
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` = (
    SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`)
    FROM frpm
);

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE "SAT Math Avg. Score" > 560 
  AND "FUNDING TYPE" = 'Direct Charter';

SELECT frpm.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(
           frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
       ) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores 
    ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / t.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    nces_school_identification_number,
    enrollment_ages_5_17
FROM schools
ORDER BY enrollment_ages_5_17 DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT d.name AS district,
       AVG(s.score) AS avg_reading_score
FROM district d
JOIN scores s ON s.district_id = d.id
WHERE d.status = 'Active'
  AND s.subject = 'Reading'
GROUP BY d.name
ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T2.City = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT s.sname AS school,
       sc.CharterNum,
       s.AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno'
  AND s.FundingType = 'Directly funded'
  AND t.NumTstTakr <= 250;

SELECT s.phone
FROM schools AS s
JOIN scores AS e
    ON e.school_id = s.school_id
WHERE e.subject = 'Math'
GROUP BY s.school_id, s.phone
ORDER BY AVG(e.score) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Amador'
  AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12';

SELECT COUNT(s.School) AS num_schools
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
  AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700;

SELECT sname AS school, numtsttakr AS test_takers
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
ORDER BY numtsttakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30;

SELECT T3.School
FROM schools AS T3
JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T3.CDSCode = T1.CDSCode
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T3.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / T1."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND (T2.AvgScrMath + T2.AvgScrRead + T2.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

SELECT s.FundingType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.FundingType
HAVING SUM(sat.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(*) > 400;

SELECT s.School,
       s.Street,
       s.City,
       s.State,
       s.Zip
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f
        ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT T1.School, T2.AvgScrWrite, T1.Phone
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) > '1991' 
   OR strftime('%Y', T1.ClosedDate) < '2000';

SELECT T1.School, T1.DOCType
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE (T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm AS T3
    JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
    WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)

SELECT Year_Opened
FROM schools
WHERE Grades = 'K-12'
ORDER BY Enrollment DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City,
       SUM(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS total_k12_enrollment
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY total_k12_enrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS frpm_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.DOC = 66
ORDER BY T1.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.School, s.Website
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey'
  AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1,
       s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2,
       s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM satscores AS sc
JOIN schools AS s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.Street, T1.City, T1.Zip, T1.State
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
ORDER BY (T2.NumGE1500 * 1.0) / T2.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T3.Website
FROM schools AS T3
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T3.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.cname = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.City = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.dname = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT School
FROM (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.County,
        sc.AvgScrRead,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.County
            ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC
        ) AS rnk
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN satscores AS sc
        ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
) ranked
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT s.education_type
FROM schools s
JOIN grades g ON s.school_id = g.school_id
WHERE g.subject = 'Math'
GROUP BY s.school_id, s.education_type
ORDER BY AVG(g.score) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AvgScrMath, cname
FROM satscores
ORDER BY AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    t.AvgScrWrite, 
    s.City
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS t 
    ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite >= 1500
ORDER BY t.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT satscores.sname AS school,
       AVG(satscores.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci'
  AND schools.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'
GROUP BY satscores.sname;

SELECT T1.School, T2.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(CDSCode) / 12 AS monthly_avg_opened
FROM schools

WITH consumption_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, CZK payments only
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        y.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM consumption_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- Customers whose consumption equals the segment minimum
    SELECT
        cc.Segment,
        COUNT(*)                  AS n_customers,
        SUM(cc.total_consumption) AS total_of_lowest
    FROM consumption_2013 AS cc
    JOIN min_per_segment AS m
      ON m.Segment         = cc.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = cc.total_consumption
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT
        Segment,
        total_of_lowest * 1.0 / n_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_vs_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_vs_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_vs_SME;

SELECT T1.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
       -
       (SELECT MIN(A11)
        FROM district
        WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id
                              FROM client
                              WHERE gender = 'F'
                                AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                                  FROM client
                                                  WHERE gender = 'F'))) AS gap
FROM client AS T2
JOIN disp AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN account AS T1 ON T3.account_id = T1.account_id
WHERE T2.gender = 'F'
  AND T2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND T2.district_id = (SELECT C.district_id
                        FROM client AS C
                        JOIN district AS D ON C.district_id = D.district_id
                        WHERE C.gender = 'F'
                          AND C.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                              FROM client
                                              WHERE gender = 'F')
                        ORDER BY D.A11
                        LIMIT 1);

JOIN disp      d  ON d.account_id  = a.account_id
JOIN client    c  ON c.client_id   = d.client_id
JOIN district  t  ON t.district_id = c.district_id
LEFT JOIN client   c2 ON c2.birth_date > c.birth_date   -- anyone younger than c?
LEFT JOIN district t2 ON t2.A11         > t.A11         -- any richer district than t?
WHERE c2.client_id   IS NULL
  AND t2.district_id IS NULL;

WITH target AS (
    -- Find the account of the loan approved first on 1993-07-05
    -- (status 'A' = approved/finished without problems)
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE status = 'A'
      AND date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_start AS (
    -- Account balance on 1993-03-22 (Date B)
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC      -- balance after the last transaction that day
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_end AS (
    -- Account balance on 1998-12-27 (Date A)
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target)
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (bal_end.balance - bal_start.balance) * 100.0
       / bal_start.balance AS increase_rate_pct
FROM bal_start, bal_end;

JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY T1.height_cm DESC;

SELECT T1.publisher_name

JOIN superhero AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.publisher_id
WHERE T2.superhero_name = 'Sauron';

SELECT 
    c.colour AS eye_colour,
    COUNT(s.id) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
GROUP BY c.colour
ORDER BY COUNT(s.id) DESC;

SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT DISTINCT T3.short_title AS Diagnosis,
       T2.charttime AS Lab_DateTime
FROM diagnoses_icd AS T1
JOIN d_icd_diagnoses AS T3
  ON T1.icd9_code = T3.icd9_code
JOIN labevents AS T2
  ON T2.subject_id = T1.subject_id
WHERE T1.subject_id = '30609';

SELECT 
    T1.SEX, 
    T1.Birthday, 
    T2.`Examination Date`, 
    T2.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH > 500;

SELECT T1.ID,
       strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM patient AS T1
JOIN examination AS T2
  ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis

SELECT DISTINCT T1.*
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND T2.`T-CHO` >= '250';

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND (l.TP < '6.0' OR l.TP > '8.5') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
    * 100 / COUNT(p.ID) AS percentage
FROM patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(T2."aCL IgG")
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND (strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) >= '50';

SELECT COUNT(ID)

  AND Admission = '-';

SELECT MIN(strftime('%Y', `First Date`) - strftime('%Y', `Birthday`)) AS age
FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = '1' 
  AND T2.`EXAMINATION DATE` LIKE '1997%' 
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS e

        WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to hospital'

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Annual (2013) consumption per CZK-paying customer, together with its segment
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'   -- equivalently: y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest annual consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS lowest_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average consumption of the lowest-consuming customer(s) per segment:
    -- total consumption per year / number of lowest-consuming customers
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS annual_average
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN lowest_per_segment l
      ON z.Segment = l.Segment
     AND z.total_consumption = l.lowest_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_average FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH elite AS (
    -- players with vision >= 90 (deduplicated, small set)
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE vision > 89
),
appearances AS (
    -- one row per (match country, player appearing in that match)
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS country
FROM appearances a
JOIN Country c ON c.id = a.country_id
WHERE a.player_api_id IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM elite);

JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_1
WHERE c.name = 'Italy';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

FROM Player 
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'

FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(id) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' 
  AND crossing = (
      SELECT MAX(crossing) 
      FROM Player_Attributes 
      WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  );

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = "Poland Ekstraklasa";

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
  AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT
    T1.sprint_speed,
    T1.agility,
    T1.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT DISTINCT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_games
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A'
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_score
FROM Match AS M

SELECT T2.finishing, T2.curve
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
ORDER BY T1.weight DESC

SELECT League.name
FROM League
JOIN Match ON League.id = Match.league_id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY COUNT(Match.id) DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (
    SELECT MAX(away_team_goal)
    FROM Match
);

SELECT T2.player_name

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' 
         ELSE '1996' 
       END
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.district_id) 
FROM district AS T1 
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id 
WHERE T2.gender = 'F' 
  AND T1.A11 > 6000 
  AND T1.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp d    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                      FROM client
                      WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND c.district_id IN (SELECT district_id
                        FROM district
                        WHERE A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11)
                                     FROM district));

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT client.client_id
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND disp.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT account.account_id
FROM account

WHERE loan.status = 'A'
  AND strftime('%Y', loan.date) = '1997'
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY loan.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE loan.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY loan.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id

  AND T2.A2 = 'Sokolov'

FROM trans t
WHERE t.date = (
    SELECT MIN(t2.date)
    FROM trans t2
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1995'
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t 
    ON a.account_id = t.account_id

  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT T1.client_id
FROM disp AS T1
JOIN card AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id
WHERE T2.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date
FROM trans

WHERE trans.amount = 840

SELECT account.district_id
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.date = '1994-08-25'

SELECT MAX(trans.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE card.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.amount
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id = (
        -- Account of the client with the biggest loan
        SELECT l.account_id
        FROM loan l
        ORDER BY l.amount DESC
        LIMIT 1
      )
  AND t.date > (
        -- Only transactions after the account was opened
        SELECT a.date
        FROM account a
        JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
        ORDER BY l.amount DESC
        LIMIT 1
      )
ORDER BY t.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) AS num_female_clients
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND client.gender = 'F';

SELECT disp.disp_id
FROM trans

SELECT COUNT(account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'

SELECT district.A2
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN client ON client.client_id = disp.client_id

  AND loan.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY account.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN client.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
        * 100 / COUNT(client.client_id) AS male_client_percentage
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND district.A4 = (SELECT MAX(A4) 
                     FROM district 
                     WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia');

SELECT 
    (t2.balance - t1.balance) * 100.0 / t1.balance AS increase_rate
FROM trans t1
JOIN trans t2 
    ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
WHERE t1.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND t2.date = '1998-12-27'
  AND t1.account_id = (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM loan
        WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
          AND status = 'A'        -- approved loan
        ORDER BY loan_id          -- the first one on that date
        LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT 
    account.account_id,
    district.A2 AS district_name,
    district.A3 AS district_region
FROM account
JOIN district 
    ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND SUBSTR(account.date, 1, 4) = '1993';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS d
    ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c
    ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district AS dt
    ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2, d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A11 AS average_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT DISTINCT 
       d.A2 AS district, 
       d.A3 AS state,
       ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS decin_account_percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

       COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM district d
JOIN client ON client.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp   ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_holders_without_card
FROM client c
JOIN disp d      ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'                       -- account holders only
  AND di.A3 = 'South Bohemia'                -- region name is in column A3
  AND c.client_id NOT IN (                   -- exclude anyone who owns a card
        SELECT d2.client_id
        FROM disp d2
        JOIN card cd ON cd.disp_id = d2.disp_id
  );

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name,
       SUM(l.amount) AS total_active_loan
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY total_active_loan DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT COUNT(account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district

    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trans.account_id) AS num_accounts

JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id

JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.account_id) AS num_accounts

JOIN loan AS t3 ON t3.account_id = t1.account_id

  );

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id

WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_credit_card_amount

FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

      FROM trans t2
      WHERE t2.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
        AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) = '1998'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients

FROM card;

JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT t.*
