SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT
  ( SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
  ) * 100.0
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d  ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS credit_card_withdrawals

WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'

    (SELECT SUM(A16) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia')

SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS num_dispositions

    -- Get the pair of elements for each bond (normalized so (C,O) == (O,C))
    SELECT DISTINCT
           c.bond_id,
           CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS el1,
           CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS el2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- Count how many bonds exist for each element combination
    SELECT el1, el2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elems
    GROUP BY el1, el2
),
most_common AS (
    -- Find the count for the most common combination
    SELECT cnt
    FROM combo_counts
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
-- Percentage = (# bonds with most common element combination) / (total # of bonds) * 100
SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT cnt FROM most_common)
             / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage;

    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS annual_avg_consumption

        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'   -- first 4 chars of Date = year 2013
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,

    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,

    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM czk_2013 WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

        M.away_player_1,  M.away_player_2,  M.away_player_3,  M.away_player_4,

    )
JOIN Country AS C
    ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT C.name AS country
FROM Country C
JOIN (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) MP ON C.id = MP.country_id

JOIN account  a  ON a.account_id  = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  -- Step 1: keep only the oldest female client(s)
  -- (older = smaller birth_date, per the hint)
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MIN(birth_date)
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
      )
  -- Step 2: among those oldest females, keep the one(s)
  -- whose district has the lowest average salary (A11)
  AND d.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'

WITH annual_consumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer (only CZK-paying customers)
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_by_segment AS (
    -- Lowest annual consumption in each segment (SME, LAM, KAM)
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM annual_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- Customers with the lowest consumption per segment:
    -- annual average = total consumption per year / number of such customers
    SELECT a.Segment,
           SUM(a.total_consumption) AS total_consumption,
           COUNT(*) AS num_customers
    FROM annual_consumption a
    JOIN min_by_segment m
      ON m.Segment = a.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = a.total_consumption
    GROUP BY a.Segment
),
avg_by_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_by_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WHERE T2.player_name = 'Daan Smith'
   OR T2.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira';

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_team_goal
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p
     ON m.home_player_1 = p.player_api_id
WHERE (STRFTIME('%Y', DATETIME(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime'))
       - STRFTIME('%Y', p.birthday)) < 31;

SELECT T2.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
GROUP BY T2.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(T1.overall_rating) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
ORDER BY T2.potential DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.attacking_work_rate = 'high'

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.finishing = 1
ORDER BY julianday(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - julianday(T1.birthday) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Match AS T2
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_1
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_2
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_3
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_4
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_5
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_6
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_7
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_8
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_9
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_10
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_11
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.away_player_1
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.away_player_2
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.away_player_3
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.away_player_4
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.away_player_5
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.away_player_6
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.away_player_7
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.away_player_8
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.away_player_9
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.away_player_10
    OR T1.player_api_id = T2.away_player_11
JOIN Country AS T3
    ON T2.country_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name,
       c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p
  ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
JOIN Match m
  ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,
                         m.home_player_4,  m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,
                         m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,  m.home_player_9,
                         m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
                         m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,
                         m.away_player_4,  m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,
                         m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,  m.away_player_9,
                         m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c
  ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT C.name
FROM Country C
JOIN Match M 
    ON C.id = M.country_id
JOIN Player P 
    ON P.player_api_id IN (
        M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, 
        M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, 
        M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
        M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, 
        M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, 
        M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    )
GROUP BY C.name
ORDER BY AVG(P.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(T1.height)
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.home_player_1
WHERE T2.country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy');

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(id) 
FROM Player 
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' 
  AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.player_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
WHERE T1.crossing = (
        SELECT MAX(T2.crossing)
        FROM Player_Attributes AS T2
    )
    AND T1.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT 
    M.home_team_goal,
    M.away_team_goal
FROM 
    Match AS M
    JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE 
    L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
    AND M.date LIKE '2008-09-24%';

SELECT T1.sprint_speed, T1.agility, T1.acceleration
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT T2.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_games
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
  AND League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT MAX(T1.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS T1
INNER JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'

SELECT T1.finishing, T1.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player)

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Match AS M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (
    SELECT MAX(away_team_goal)
    FROM Match
);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.height < 180 AND T2.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' 
  AND district.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.district_id)
FROM district AS T1
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T2.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.A11 > 6000
  AND T1.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT T3.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - T1.A11 AS gap
FROM district AS T1
JOIN client  AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
JOIN disp    AS T3 ON T2.client_id   = T3.client_id
WHERE T2.gender = 'F'
  AND T2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                       FROM client
                       WHERE gender = 'F')
ORDER BY T1.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND district.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id)
FROM disp
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE disp.type = 'Owner'
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT T1.client_id 
FROM client AS T1 
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id 
JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id 
WHERE T3.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' 
  AND T2.type = 'DISPONENT'

FROM account
WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

        SELECT account_id
        FROM loan
        WHERE status = 'A'
          AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1997'
          AND amount = (
                SELECT MIN(amount)
                FROM loan
                WHERE status = 'A'
                  AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1997'
              )
      );

SELECT account_id
FROM account
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1993'
  AND account_id IN (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM loan
        WHERE duration > 12
          AND amount = (SELECT MAX(amount)
                        FROM loan
                        WHERE duration > 12)
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1.client_id = T3.client_id
INNER JOIN account AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id

SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE date = (
    SELECT MIN(date)
    FROM trans
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
);

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM account
JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id
WHERE account.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND loan.amount > 3000;

SELECT T1.client_id
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN card AS T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id
WHERE T3.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT A.district_id
FROM loan AS L
JOIN account AS A ON L.account_id = A.account_id

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d  ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c  ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)

LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.amount
FROM trans AS T1
JOIN loan AS L  ON T1.account_id = L.account_id
JOIN disp AS D  ON L.account_id  = D.account_id
JOIN client AS C ON D.client_id  = C.client_id
JOIN account AS A ON T1.account_id = A.account_id
WHERE L.amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
  AND T1.date > A.date
ORDER BY T1.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
WHERE gender = 'F' 
  AND district_id IN (
      SELECT district_id 
      FROM district 
      WHERE A2 = 'Jesenik'
  );

SELECT T1.disp_id
FROM disp AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.amount = 5100
  AND T2.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT T4.A2
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T1.birth_date = '1976-01-29' AND T1.gender = 'F'

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN disp   ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832
  AND loan.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE di.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS male_client_percentage
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT d.district_id
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY d.A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT ((t2.balance - t1.balance) / t1.balance) * 100 AS balance_increase_rate
FROM trans t1
JOIN trans t2 
  ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
WHERE t1.date = '1993-03-22'
  AND t2.date = '1998-12-27'
  AND t1.account_id = (
        SELECT d.account_id
        FROM loan l
        JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
        WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
        ORDER BY l.loan_id
        LIMIT 1
      );

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage_of_loan_amount_paid_no_issue
FROM loan;

SELECT T1.account_id, T2.A2, T2.A3
FROM account AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE substr(T1.date, 1, 2) = '93'
  AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d 
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) BETWEEN '1995' AND '2000';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT district.A2, district.A3
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.loan_id = '4990';

SELECT l.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A2, d.A11
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

SELECT district.A2, 
       district.A3, 
       ((district.A13 - district.A12) / district.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_rate
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.status = 'D';

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.date LIKE '1993%';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, 
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS account_holders_without_card
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp   ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND dp.disp_id NOT IN (SELECT disp_id FROM card);

SELECT T3.A3
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id
WHERE T1.status IN ('C', 'D')
ORDER BY T1.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT A3 AS branch_location,
       A2 AS district_name
FROM district
WHERE A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13)
             FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(account_id) 
FROM account 
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id 
    FROM district 
    ORDER BY A16 DESC 
    LIMIT 1
);

JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id

      ORDER BY A15 DESC

  );

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT COUNT(*)

JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT card.type

SELECT
    -- Which group is larger? (1 = more in-patients, 0 = more outpatients)
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_more_inpatient,
    -- Deviation in percentage: (male in-patients / male outpatients) * 100
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TP < 6.0;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID,
       T2.Date,
       T2.ALB,
       CASE WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA_index
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
      )
  AND (
        (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
     OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.UN = 29;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`)
    FROM Laboratory
)

SELECT T1.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY T1.SEX;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
ORDER BY T2.`T-CHO` DESC, T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) / COUNT(Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' 
    AND T1.SEX = 'M' 
    AND T2.CPK >= 250

SELECT DISTINCT 
    T1.ID, 
    T1.SEX, 
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU >= 180 
  AND T2."T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU < 180
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5 OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY P.SEX, P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT P.ID, 
       P.Diagnosis, 
       (strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.RBC, T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) >= 50 
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-'
  AND Laboratory.HGB < 10;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.HGB > 10
  AND T2.HGB < 17
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.ID,
       (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID
HAVING COUNT(T2.ID) > 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_lower,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_higher,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50
  AND CAST(T2.PLT AS REAL) BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T.PT >= 14 AND T.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / SUM(CASE WHEN T.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT L.PT, P.SEX
    FROM Patient AS P
    JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) 
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55
) AS T;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992'
  AND T2.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' 
  AND T2.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.WBC > 3.5 
  AND T2.WBC < 9.0 
  AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' 
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450)

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGG > 900
  AND Laboratory.IGG < 2000
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY T2.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.IGA > 80
  AND Laboratory.IGA < 500
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE IGM <= 40 OR IGM >= 400
)
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' 
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) >= '1985'
  AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-');

SELECT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.RF < 20 
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND T3.Thrombosis = '0';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.C3 > 35
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT T2.ID
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.HCT <= 29 OR T1.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T2.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T2.`aCL IgA`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 1
  AND T3.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.RNP IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0')
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0') 
ORDER BY T1.`First Date` ASC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND T3.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0') 
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T1.SEX = 'M'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE T1.ID IN (
    SELECT T2.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS T2
    WHERE T2.DNA >= 8
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.DNA < 8 AND T2.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T1.Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GOT < 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT < 60
ORDER BY T2.GPT DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT < 60 AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS first_recorded_date
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH = (
    SELECT MAX(LDH)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH < 500
);

SELECT MAX(T2.Date)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`First Date` = (
    SELECT MAX(`First Date`)
    FROM Patient
)
  AND T2.LDH >= 500;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP >= 300
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TP < 6.0
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND T2.TP > 6.0
  AND T2.TP < 8.5;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT E.`aCL IgG`, E.`aCL IgM`, E.`aCL IgA`
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.UA <= 6.50          -- uric acid within the normal range (upper limit = 6.50)
ORDER BY L.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T2.ID
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.ANA 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` < 2.0 
ORDER BY T2.`T-BIL` DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-CHO` >= 250
  AND T3.KCT = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.`T-CHO` < 250 
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 0
  AND T3.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CPK < 250
  AND (T2.KCT = '+' OR T2.RVVT = '+' OR T2.LAC = '+')

SELECT MIN(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU > 180;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.GLU < 180 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Admission = '+' 
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0;

SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.ID
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0)
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.PLT > 100 
  AND T2.PLT < 400 
  AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;

SELECT T1.PLT
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND T1.PLT > 100
  AND T1.PLT < 400;

SELECT AVG(T2.PT) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.PT < 14

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE (T2.Thrombosis = 2 OR T2.Thrombosis = 1)
  AND T3.PT < 14;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_oxygen_atoms
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T3.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS avg_single_bonds
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'na'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#' AND T1.label = '+'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099' 
  AND label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2
  ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T3.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'h'
GROUP BY T2.label
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.label) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T3.bond_type
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id, a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT T2.element, COUNT(T2.element) AS cnt
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'

top_names AS (
    SELECT admin_first_name

    WHERE admin_first_name IS NOT NULL

WITH czk_consumption AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, limited to CZK-paying customers
    SELECT c.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_average AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consumption customers
    --                 / number of those customers
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cc.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_consumption cc
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cc.Segment = m.Segment
     AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

     -
     SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100.0

    AS percentage_increase
FROM customers AS c

WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'

  AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC;

JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

INNER JOIN Player AS T2

FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.overall_rating = 77
  AND T1.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'

LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'
  AND T1.date LIKE '2016-02-04%';

SELECT T2.potential 
FROM Player AS T1 
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 
ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

SELECT T1.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id

      SELECT MAX(PA2.crossing)

      WHERE P2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'

LIMIT 1;

FROM Team_Attributes
INNER JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Willem II'

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'LEI'

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id

SELECT Team_Attributes.chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id

SELECT TA.chanceCreationCrossingClass

JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass

JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating)
FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND substr(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT (
    (SELECT PA.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
     JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
     WHERE P.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
       AND PA.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')
    -
    (SELECT PA.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
     JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
     WHERE P.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
       AND PA.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')
) * 100.0 /
    (SELECT PA.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
     JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
     WHERE P.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
       AND PA.date LIKE '2013-07-12%');

FROM (
    SELECT player_name,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS height_rank
    FROM Player

FROM Match m
JOIN Player p1 ON p1.player_name = 'Daan Smith'
JOIN Player p2 ON p2.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira'
WHERE p1.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
      )
  AND p2.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
      );

SELECT SUM(T1.home_team_goal) AS total_home_team_goals
FROM Match AS T1
INNER JOIN Player AS T2
    ON T2.player_api_id IN (
        T1.home_player_1,  T1.home_player_2,  T1.home_player_3,  T1.home_player_4,
        T1.home_player_5,  T1.home_player_6,  T1.home_player_7,  T1.home_player_8,
        T1.home_player_9,  T1.home_player_10, T1.home_player_11
    )
WHERE (JULIANDAY(DATETIME('now', 'localtime')) - JULIANDAY(T2.birthday)) / 365.25 < 31;

FROM Player AS T1

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1

FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p

        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,

FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player 
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' 
  AND birthday > '1990';
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS difference;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'right'
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) 
  AND preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN stamina > 80 AND strength > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT 
    m.home_team_goal,
    m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
  AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

FROM Match

  AND league_id = (

      WHERE name = 'Italy Serie A'
  );

FROM Match AS M
INNER JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT T1.finishing, T1.curve
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_fifa_api_id = T2.player_fifa_api_id
ORDER BY T2.weight DESC
LIMIT 1;

FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY League.name
ORDER BY COUNT(Match.id) DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)

SELECT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' 
  AND district.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account AS T1 
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id 
JOIN loan AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id 
WHERE T2.A3 = 'Prague'

SELECT 
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        WHEN AVG(A13) > AVG(A12) THEN '1996'
        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) 
FROM client c 
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id 
WHERE c.gender = 'M' 
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT T2.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - T4.A11 AS gap
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                       FROM client
                       WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND T4.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11)
                FROM district
                WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id
                                      FROM client
                                      WHERE gender = 'F'
                                        AND birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                                                          FROM client
                                                          WHERE gender = 'F')));

SELECT d.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND dt.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_owners
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT T1.client_id 
FROM client AS T1 
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id 
JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id 
WHERE T2.type = 'DISPONENT' 
  AND T3.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('A', 'C')                          -- approved loans
  AND strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'                 -- loan approved in 1997
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'                  -- weekly issuance statement
  AND l.amount = (
        SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
        FROM loan l2
        WHERE l2.status IN ('A', 'C')
          AND strftime('%Y', l2.date) = '1997'
  );

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN loan AS T2
  ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.duration > 12
  AND T1.date LIKE '93%'          -- account opened in 1993 (dates stored as YYMMDD)
ORDER BY T2.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
JOIN account ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', client.birth_date) < '1950'
  AND district.A2 = 'Sokolov';

SELECT account_id, MIN(date) AS earliest_trading_date
FROM trans
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING MIN(date) BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY a.account_id
HAVING SUM(t.amount) > 3000;

SELECT T3.client_id
FROM card AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id
JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
WHERE T1.issued LIKE '1994-03-03%';

SELECT account.date
FROM account
JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT a.district_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.date = '1994-08-25'
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT MAX(T1.amount) 
FROM trans AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN disp AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN card AS T4 ON T3.disp_id = T4.disp_id
WHERE T4.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T3.amount
FROM account AS T1
JOIN trans AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T1.account_id = (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
  AND T3.date > T1.date
ORDER BY T3.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_female_clients
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'F';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM disp AS d
JOIN trans AS t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT d.A2 
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' 
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN client.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(client.client_id) AS male_client_percentage
FROM account
JOIN disp    ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN client  ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN district ON district.district_id = account.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND district.A4 = (
        SELECT MAX(A4)
        FROM district
        WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
      );

SELECT 
    ((T1.balance - T2.balance) / T2.balance) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM trans AS T1
JOIN trans AS T2 
    ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.date = '1998-12-27'      -- balance at Date A
  AND T2.date = '1993-03-22'      -- balance at Date B
  AND T1.account_id = (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM loan
        WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
          AND status = 'A'        -- approved loan
        ORDER BY loan_id
        LIMIT 1
      );

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage
FROM loan;

SELECT T1.account_id, T2.A2, T2.A3
FROM account AS T1
JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
WHERE T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1993'

SELECT c.client_id, 
       a.account_id, 
       a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '2000-12-31'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

    SELECT e.event_id,
           e.event_name,
           SUM(x.cost) AS cost
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    JOIN expense x ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
    WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
)
